body:
CI-RS-1: bounded publisher admission / release-note routine readback for independent holders; no source or live execution authorization.

Root compared the accepted interface CLI lines 14-15 and 30-32, CI-RS-02 reason table and design D4 against the separate routine proposal SHA256 a431d5d1796b5930c34875c4767f1d0a8ac8dc487ca0444eff71c0c73d96d104. Accepted subject bytes and their existing approvals remain unchanged.

Bare --commit without a value: USAGE_ERROR / INVALID_INVOCATION. Parsed non-exact repository confirmation, missing/invalid/non-exact plan digest (including a syntactically valid stale 64-hex digest at initial admission): USAGE_ERROR / INVALID_CONFIRMATION before any effect. Actual origin or manifest repository mismatch: RED / REPOSITORY_MISMATCH. Actual bound-input drift after exact plan admission: RED / INPUT_CHANGED, preserving any already observed effects and forbidding dependent actions. Wrong-kind or stale D8 record remains RED / INVALID_CONFIRMATION. These are separate single-fact axes.

The normal committed release entrypoint handles the note after exact tag identity and ancestry verification: read the exact release object, issue one note POST only after confirmed absence, reuse exact existing identity, and refuse conflict. Lost write response requires bounded exact readback and no automatic write retry. Failure preserves the confirmed tag and TAG_PRESENT stage. Explicit resume first reads existing identities. Probe is read-only and never creates a note. D4 permits a later note operation but does not require a new CLI phase or flag; none is added.

This record fixes routine holder vocabulary only. It does not assert prepared publisher fixtures, semantic RED, complete T1/T5, D8 authority, release, main delivery or issue closure. All actual prerequisites, closed effects and single-fact lawful twins remain required.
